clarifications.initialObservation: Point-source phrase appeared bold in full-page inspection.
clarifications.detailObservation: The detail does not establish an intentional bold span for 点光源 distinct from surrounding regular text. Initial bold attribution is not promoted to a finding; only 光通量的单位 is positively confirmed bold.
Two separate under-character emphasis dots under the first 流明 are visible. The printed punctuation after 作为光通量的单位 is a comma, not a full stop.
The two-line illuminance definition, including Φ, S and E, is bold. The next display formula E=Φ/S (6.5) is regular and complete on one visual line.
The three characters 勒克斯 each have a lower emphasis dot; 1流明 and 1米² are printed. Squared exponent applies to 米, not to the preceding numeral.
Footnote ① 从前这个单位叫烛光 is a separate line below a horizontal rule. Its unique callout is in the second visual line of the basic-unit paragraph, before the n68 heading.
